title: Xattr existence errors
scope: Namespace xattr get and remove of a missing name, and replace of a missing name, report ENOATTR on macOS and ENODATA elsewhere.
Creating an xattr whose name already exists reports EEXIST.
C++ Namespace errors use std::system_error with generic_category; raw RPC encodes the errno as errno + 1 for path, handle and inode xattr operations.
Only the four Xattrs existence checks changed. Name/policy/value validation and quota, protection, revision and handle policy ordering were preserved by source review.
explicit_exclusions: No blanket translation of generic runtime errors to POSIX errnos.
No dedicated validation/protection/readonly/precedence probes are claimed; those paths were preserved by source review.
Cursor preservation was checked at the initial cursor position; no duplicate-handle shared-cursor or nonzero-cursor probe is claimed.
No native FSKit errno mapping or native mount test is claimed.

baseline.observed_cpp: The final C++ regression binary stopped at missing get: the old implementation threw generic runtime_error rather than a typed xattr errno.
baseline.observed_raw_rpc: The final raw RPC regression stopped at missing path get: the old server returned wire status 1 rather than ENOATTR + 1 on macOS.
baseline.qualification: Only these first missing-get failures were independently observed on baseline; other baseline error cases are not claimed.
